description: Interior-mutability cells and guard escape boundaries

expected.contract: Cell value9, old-output sentinel71 and one reader: replace(4) returns BUSY, leaves value9 and sentinel71. Read succeeds with9; write through that reader returns INVALID. After release, reading with the old token returns STALE and replace publishes4 while returning old9.

verification_method: Independent state/set oracle recomputes cases.json; prose and changed conditions are assessed separately.
